steps.t: Fair teams before the first question
steps.d: Catch builds teams of five from who’s coming: people on their own spread across teams, friends kept together if they asked, and no team stacked with regulars.

steps.t: A team for everyone at the door
steps.d: Guests check in and see their team and table. Anyone who came alone is introduced to their team by name before round one.
One person from each team moves on. Only the people moving get a buzz; everyone else stays in the game.
The quizmaster enters each round’s scores. Teams see their own; the leaderboard stays hidden, so the last round still matters.
A countdown on every phone and the big screen at once, then the final standings. The winners pick next week’s theme.

data.title: What quizmasters and venues ask us.
items: Catch builds teams of five from who’s coming: people on their own spread across teams, friends kept together if they asked, and no team stacked with regulars. You can move anyone before round one.
Can friends play on the same team?
Yes. Players who ask to be together are kept together, and Catch balances the rest of the room around them.
Do players need to download an app?
No. Players book on your page and join live moments, like their team and the reveal, in their phone’s browser.
Can I show the reveal on a screen?
Yes. The countdown and final standings appear on every phone and the big screen at once.
Can a venue run a free quiz?
Yes. Free events stay free on Catch, every week. The 5% fee applies only to paid tickets.
Can I bring my player list from another tool?
Yes. Import your list from any tool. Nothing changes for players until the night.
